title: Graffiti Punk Girl
description: A stylized female character with voluminous, wild red and magenta hair stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a red leather-like outfit with gold accents, a short cape, and tall red platform boots while aiming a spray can that emits a bright pink and purple paint burst.
